description.en: Shorthand for CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_Animal with its _shadow argument forced to true — creates a shadow-casting, low-detail animal-type NPC model.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC number used to build the model's file path.
Optional; when true, skips creating the matching bustup portrait (defaults to false).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a shadow-casting animal-type NPC model
local hAnimalL = CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_Animal_Shadow("animalL", 5);
